description: This file defines the LeaveAPI class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It provides API endpoints for managing leave requests, including listing leaves associated with a request, updating leave statuses, and handling related data. The class uses multiple traits and external models to process leave-related data and conforms to a RESTful API design with OpenAPI annotations.
